What sets Mission Services apart is that it is built on a foundation of Christian faith and belief system. At the core of their basic principles is God the Trinity, as proclaimed in ancient Christian teaching, and they center their principles on Jesus Christ, the living Word of God, and His message found throughout Scripture.

about_blocks.text: Mission Services of London is a non-profit social service agency committed to serving London and the surrounding areas with compassion and hope. They have been operating as a Christian faith-based organization since 1951, with a mission to provide hope and support to those in need. Mission Services of London has five branches of services: The Men’s Mission and Rehabilitation Centre, Rotholme Women’s and Family Shelter, Quintin Warner House (Addiction Treatment), Community Mental Health Programs, and the Mission Store (Thrift Store).
about_blocks.html: Mission Services of London is a non-profit social service agency committed to serving London and the surrounding areas with compassion and hope. They have been operating as a Christian faith-based organization since 1951, with a mission to provide hope and support to those in need. Mission Services of London has five branches of services: The Men’s Mission and Rehabilitation Centre, Rotholme Women’s and Family Shelter, Quintin Warner House (Addiction Treatment), Community Mental Health Programs, and the Mission Store (Thrift Store).

about_blocks.text: The Men’s Mission and Rehabilitation Centre provides emergency shelter, food, and support to homeless men, while the Rotholme Women’s and Family Shelter provides similar services to women and families. The Quintin Warner House offers addiction treatment programs for both men and women, while Community Mental Health Programs provide support and assistance to individuals struggling with mental health issues. The Mission Store is a thrift store that helps fund Mission Services of London’s programs and services.
